name: Git Master
description: An IntelliJ-IDEA-style Git & multi-repo tool window for PI-Desktop: multi-repo batch pull/commit/push, staged/unstaged change lists, hunk-level stage & revert, branch switcher, graph log and stashes. 全能 Git 工具窗口：多仓库一键拉取/提交/推送、暂存/未暂存分组、代码块暂存与还原、分支切换、图形化日志与储藏。
author: Corner19

en.name: Git Master
en.description: An IntelliJ-IDEA-style Git & multi-repo tool window for PI-Desktop: multi-repo batch pull/commit/push, staged/unstaged change lists, hunk-level stage & revert, commit, branch switcher, graph log and stashes.
en.safetyNotes: Reads workspace files through the host fs APIs (Open File / Reveal only); discarding an untracked file deletes it (with a confirmation dialog) — every other write goes through Git commands. Commit-message generation calls the host model with your own model setup and quota (host rate limit 8/min); the plugin holds no API keys, makes no network requests, no telemetry. HTTPS credentials come from your own Git credential helper; keys that live only in ssh-agent do not work — use an HTTPS remote or a keychain-backed key.

zh-CN.name: 全能 Git
zh-CN.description: PI-Desktop 的全能 Git 工具窗口：支持多仓库一键拉取/提交/推送、暂存/未暂存分组、代码块暂存与还原、提交、分支切换、图形化日志与储藏。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只读工作区文件（Open File / Reveal 走宿主 fs 接口）；丢弃未跟踪文件时会直接删除该文件（操作前有确认框），其余写操作一律走 Git 命令。生成提交信息调用宿主模型，用的是你自己的模型配置与额度（宿主限流 8 次/分），插件不持有任何 API Key，不发起网络请求，无遥测。HTTPS 凭据走你自己的 Git 凭据助手；只活在 ssh-agent 里的密钥用不了，请用 HTTPS 远端或钥匙串密钥。

changelog: Release 0.3.1: Unify Commit and Git into one Git work-panel entry; show Commit and Log together with a draggable splitter, with optional Commit, Log and Console modes. 提交与 Git 合并为一个 Git 工作面板入口，支持提交与日志上下分屏、拖动分隔条以及单独查看提交、日志和控制台。
